description:
## Why This Exists

post/ipfs_write.rs::KuboBlockStore::put_block() calls self.client.block_put() which returns a CID, but the returned CID is discarded (not compared against the caller-supplied cid argument). If Kubo assigns a different CID (e.g. normalisation, codec mismatch), the cache is populated with the wrong key and subsequent get_raw calls miss.

The caller is documented as 'responsible for ensuring cid matches the content of data' but there is no assertion or log to catch mismatches in production.

## Acceptance Criteria

After block_put returns, assert or log-warn if returned_cid != supplied cid.
title: KuboBlockStore::put_block discards returned CID from Kubo
